Odd One Out Game

Spot the odd one out — a grid of emojis hides one that is slightly different. Find it fast to climb levels with a shrinking timer.

Find the different emoji!

📖 How to use

  1. Press Start.
  2. Find the emoji that is different from the rest.
  3. Tap it before the timer runs out.
  4. Clear levels to face bigger grids and trickier pairs.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do you play?

Find the one emoji that differs from all the others and tap it. Each level adds more tiles and less time.

Does it get harder?

Later levels use near-identical pairs (😀/😃, 🍎/🍏) and bigger grids with tighter timers.

Is there a penalty for wrong taps?

Wrong taps cost 2 seconds of your remaining time.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — fully touch friendly.
